name: Aerospace Industrial Development
summary: Aerospace Industrial Development Corporation (AIDC), headquartered in Taichung City, Taiwan, is a key global player in the aerospace industry. The company specializes in the comprehensive lifecycle management of aerospace systems and components, from initial development and design to manufacturing, assembly, integration, and rigorous testing. Its extensive portfolio includes the development and production of military aircraft and helicopters, components for commercial aviation, and both aeronautical and industrial engines. AIDC is also deeply involved in the manufacturing, maintenance, and modernization of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and military aircraft, alongside the fabrication of specialized military hardware. The corporation provides original equipment manufacturing (OEM) services for aircraft structural elements and sub-assemblies, as well as for international commercial jet engines and their associated parts and components. Beyond production, AIDC delivers a full spectrum of aviation services, covering research and development, engineering design, manufacturing support, advanced testing, system integration, and comprehensive after-sales assistance. Its extensive maintenance capabilities span flight line operations, intermediate and depot-level repairs, specialized upkeep for instruments, electronics, accessories, and avionics test equipment, along with harness fabrication, avionics overhaul, and the production of advanced avionic systems. Further offerings include specialized flight operations such as flight testing, in-flight verification of airborne systems, aerial data collection, and pilot training, complemented by information technology solutions and comprehensive logistical support. AIDC's diversified interests also extend to railway systems, automotive electronics, power and energy solutions, and auxiliary power units (APUs) for commercial aircraft. Originally established in 1969 as the Aero Industry Development Center, AIDC has grown to become a cornerstone of Taiwan's advanced manufacturing sector.
